question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Operating cash flow over net income on a trailing-four-quarter basis is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, above the two most recent fiscal years ({earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} for 2025 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} for 2024) but below the earlier years ({earnings_versus_cash.history.years.4.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} for 2021). Accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}, more negative than the annual {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} for 2025 and {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} for 2024: cash is running further ahead of income, not behind it. Quarterly operating cash flow rose {growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct} year over year against net income growth of {growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct}; the driver the release and MD&A name is deferred revenue, with the six-month deferred-revenue line in the cash-flow statement more than doubling, plus accrued liabilities swinging from a use to a source. Working capital absorbs little: the year-over-year receivables build is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct} of trailing net income, inventory {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct}, and payables supply {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct}. Articulation: the receivables gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap} and payables gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap} are small; the inventory gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap} is large against a balance-sheet change of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change}, because the cash-flow statement records a bigger build ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.cash_flow_statement_change}) than the net balance shows, and the inventory reserve fell from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory_reserve} to {terms.balances_now.inventory_reserve} over the same span, a non-cash movement of the kind that opens such a gap. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}: net income moves far less quarter to quarter than operating cash flow, which fits a subscription model with lumpy collections but also means income is the smoothed series. Quarterly operating cash flow slipped {growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct} from the first quarter while net income rose {growth.net_income.quarter_over_quarter|pct}. The numbers reader could not fill quarterly accruals because the record holds no three-month operating cash flow row.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: cash backs earnings comfortably and more so than in the last two fiscal years; the one articulation question sits in inventory and ties to the falling reserve

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivables are not outrunning revenue. Quarterly days sales outstanding are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, down from the first quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} (highest of six filled quarters) and below the year-ago {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}; trailing DSO on average balances is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}; receivables over quarterly revenue are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}. Contract liabilities move with revenue rather than against it: current deferred revenue rose, non-current deferred revenue rose and remaining performance obligations are higher at each successive filing, yet current contract liabilities over quarterly revenue fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}, lowest of six filled quarters, from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} a quarter earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} a year earlier. The reason is mix: quarterly revenue grew {growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} and the growth is led by product, which is recognized on shipment and never passes through deferred revenue. MD&A attributes product growth to higher unit shipments, higher average selling prices and recent pricing actions. That raises a timing question: a price rise invites customers and distributors to buy ahead, and the release's third-quarter billings guidance sits below the second quarter's billings while third-quarter operating-margin and EPS guidance also sit below the quarter just reported. The balances do not show a pull-forward: Distributor A's share of receivables fell to {concentration.facts.36.value} from {concentration.facts.22.value} at year end, and service revenue recognized from opening contract liabilities rose. The question is therefore open, not answered. No policy wording change, new judgment area, bill-and-hold term or fourth-quarter concentration appears in the notes carried as text; the MD&A sales-channel paragraph now mentions third-party cloud marketplaces and the billings paragraph mentions installment billings, but the notes reader could not tell whether either sentence is new. The 10-K tags current deferred revenue under a different concept from the 10-Qs at the same value, a tag change and not a restatement.
revenue_recognition.verdict: no sign of aggressive recognition; the one timing question is a product surge tied to pricing actions beside softer next-quarter billings guidance

estimates_and_reserves.finding: The inventory reserve is thinning against its own history. Reserve over net inventory is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}, lowest of six filled quarters, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} a quarter earlier, {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} a year earlier and a peak of {trend_table.quarters-back-5.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}; annually it was {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} at the end of 2025 against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} at the end of 2024. The reserve balance fell from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory_reserve} to {terms.balances_now.inventory_reserve} while net inventory rose from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory} to {terms.balances_now.inventory}, and inventory write-downs are tagged at {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down} over the trailing four quarters. The note states the balances and says write-downs were not material but gives no cause; a reserve that falls while the balance rises, with no write-down tagged, reflects either scrapping of fully reserved stock or a lower provision rate, and the filing does not say which. The liability for excess purchase commitments also fell while the commitments themselves roughly doubled, and the sentence that had stated a prior-year benefit was dropped from the note, again without a cause. The amount of the reserve change is not a calculator field, so no adjustment is written. Elsewhere the picture is clean: the credit-loss allowance has no quarter-end row (annual ratio {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} for 2025 against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} for 2024, and MD&A cites a higher six-month provision); no warranty accrual is tagged in any period, which for a hardware company is itself a gap in the record; goodwill is unchanged with no impairment; the quarterly effective tax rate is slightly higher than a year ago and the trailing rate is {tax_rate|pct}, with no valuation-allowance release and no discrete benefit, the growing FDII deduction moving with income; unrecognized tax benefits rose slightly with audits focused on intercompany profit allocation.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: one adverse estimate signal, the inventory reserve ratio at a six-quarter low with no stated cause; tax, goodwill and the credit-loss provision raise nothing

cost_deferral.finding: No software development cost is capitalized (the record carries no such tag) and research and development is expensed; trailing R&D expense is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense} and rose in the quarter. The one growing deferral is contract costs: six-month capitalized deferred contract costs, mainly sales commissions, exceed six-month amortization by a widening margin and the balance rose over the half-year, while segment sales commissions rose in step with revenue. This is the standard treatment of incremental commissions, and amortization is rising too, so the deferral grows with bookings rather than running ahead of them, but a growing slice of selling cost is being spread into future periods. Soft assets over total assets are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share} a quarter earlier and third lowest of six filled quarters, though above the year-ago level; the 2025 annual figure was {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}. On non-recurring items: the gain on intellectual property matters excluded from non-GAAP results recurs every quarter, but it is a gain, so excluding it lowers rather than lifts non-GAAP income. The non-GAAP to GAAP gap is stock-based compensation, which rose year over year in the quarter; trailing share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}, above the 2025 fiscal-year figure of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.share_based_compensation}. The non-GAAP tax adjustment applies a higher rate than the GAAP rate and so reduces non-GAAP income. The record carries no non-GAAP measure, so the trend table has no gap series; all margin and EPS guidance is non-GAAP and unreconciled.
cost_deferral.verdict: no cost deferral beyond commissions capitalized under the standard; non-GAAP adjustments are conventional and the add-back that matters is stock compensation

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: No receivables factoring and no supplier-finance programme is tagged in any period (the calculator's proceeds-from-sale-of-receivables and supplier-finance-obligation fields are both missing), and MD&A states there are no off-balance-sheet arrangements. Operating cash flow is lifted by customer prepayment, the six-month deferred-revenue line having more than doubled; that is cash from customers, not engineering. Two presentation points stand out. First, the release defines an 'adjusted free cash flow' that adds real-estate purchases back on top of free cash flow, while the 10-Q MD&A defines only free cash flow; the add-back is small this quarter and large a year ago, and it treats land bought for data centres and offices as outside the business. Second, the 10-K and the 10-Q use different capital-expenditure tags, and in the 10-Q the real-estate purchase sits under the productive-assets tag separately from purchases of property and equipment, so trailing capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} mixes two tags, as the calculator flags; whether the six-month property-and-equipment line includes the real-estate outlay cannot be told from the record. Cash taxes paid for the six months are below the prior year while the tax provision is higher, a cash-versus-book gap that helps operating cash flow and is not explained in the prose. Off balance sheet, non-cancelable inventory purchase commitments roughly doubled from year end per MD&A, with a multi-year component supply and pricing arrangement disclosed; the calculator has no purchase-obligation field, so the amount cannot be cited here. Operating lease liability is {terms.balances_now.operating_lease_liability} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.operating_lease_liability} a year earlier; no guarantee exposure is tagged and no variable-interest entity is mentioned. Share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} is already subtracted in quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} against simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}. Trailing repurchases of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases} exceed trailing net income; equity fell to {terms.balances_now.stockholders_equity} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.stockholders_equity}, and debt fell to {terms.debt_now} from {terms.debt_a_year_earlier} after the senior-note repayment.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: no financing dressed as operations; the off-balance-sheet item is a doubling of purchase commitments the record cannot quantify, and the release's adjusted free cash flow flatters capital spending

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: The controls item concludes disclosure controls are effective and reports no change in internal control; there is no auditor change, no material weakness, no auditor-change or non-reliance item on the 8-K index, no officer-departure item after May 2025, no late-filing notice and no amendment; a 10-Q carries no critical audit matters. Signals that are present and listed rather than skipped: the chief financial officer and chief operating officer each adopted a prearranged trading plan in June 2026, before this release, both disclosed and the CFO's for a trivial share count plus net RSU and PSU shares; the prior quarter's subsequent-events note was removed and the current filing has none, and the remaining repurchase authorization at quarter end reads the same as the value the prior 10-Q gave as of early May, implying no repurchases in the back half of the quarter; the consolidation note dropped its functional-currency sentences, including the January 2026 change of one subsidiary's functional currency to the dollar, in the same quarter MD&A cites higher foreign-exchange losses; the receivables-concentration disclosure no longer carries a Distributor C row (C was {concentration.facts.29.value} of receivables in the first-quarter 10-Q); current deferred revenue is tagged under a different concept in the 10-K than in the 10-Qs at the same value, a tag change and not a restatement, and the numbers reader found no restated prior value. Related parties: nothing in the notes carried as text. No SEC comment letter and no subsidiary-list change is in the inputs.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: clean on controls and audit; several small disclosure removals and two officer trading plans are the only signals

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The release and the 10-Q agree. The numbers reader compared twelve headline figures (revenue, product and service revenue, net income, diluted EPS and share count, current deferred revenue, receivables, inventory, property and equipment, six-month repurchases and the tax provision) and found no difference, and the release's three-month operating cash flow matches the calculator's derived quarter of {growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}. The release carries two things the 10-Q does not: the Intel security-processor collaboration, while the 10-Q discloses multi-year component supply and pricing arrangements without naming a counterparty, and the adjusted free cash flow measure. Across the notes items with a directional expectation, the numbers confirm the great majority (repurchases drawing down cash and equity year over year, lower other income and interest income, product and service revenue growth, higher operating margin, higher R&D, sales-and-marketing and G&A expense, higher operating cash flow on deferred revenue, the land purchase, the raised revenue outlook) and contradict none; the unresolved items are those the calculator has no field for (purchase commitments, the credit-loss allowance at quarter end, product-level gross margin) and the forward-looking margin outlooks.

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: the reserve ratio is at a six-quarter low ({trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}) while quarterly days of inventory are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, second lowest of six, against a 2025 annual figure of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, second highest of five years; finished goods rose. Faster turns can support a lower reserve, but the filing does not make that argument and no write-down is tagged. Purchase commitments in excess of need: non-cancelable commitments roughly doubled from year end per MD&A, citing demand, lead times and component costs, with a multi-year supply and pricing arrangement, and the liability for excess commitments fell; commitments at that scale against net inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory} are the main exposure if hardware demand turns, and the calculator carries no purchase-obligation field. Customer concentration: three distributors, A at {concentration.facts.30.value}, B at {concentration.facts.32.value} and C at {concentration.facts.34.value} of quarterly revenue, are stable to slightly lower against the year-ago quarter (C was {concentration.facts.16.value}); Distributor A's share of receivables fell to {concentration.facts.36.value} from {concentration.facts.22.value} at year end and B's is {concentration.facts.37.value}. Channel stuffing: no sign in the balances, with DSO down, distributor receivable share down, deferred revenue up and revenue recognized from opening contract liabilities up, but product revenue rose sharply on recent pricing actions and next-quarter billings guidance sits below this quarter's billings, which is the pattern to watch. Circular or vendor-financed deals: nothing found; equity-method results are small, the prior-year Linksys items sit only in the comparative, and no investment in a customer is disclosed.
industry_lens.verdict: inventory reserve and purchase commitments are the hardware-specific watch items; concentration is stable and the numbers show no channel evidence

No number bears on the audit jurisdictions; the small rise in unrecognized benefits is consistent with ongoing audits but does not test the paragraph.

The remaining authorization at quarter end reads the same as the value the prior 10-Q gave as of early May, consistent with the removed note's repurchases having been completed within the quarter and none after.

Six-month repurchases more than doubled year over year and diluted shares fell; cash and equity are both lower than a year earlier ({terms.balances_now.cash} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.cash}), though cash is above year end because operating cash flow outran the buyback.
Other income—net fell sharply in the quarter while rising for six months, the equity-securities balance fell after first-quarter sales, and six-month sales of investments rose.
Other income—net fell in the quarter as MD&A says; the foreign-exchange component is not separately tagged.

Interest income and interest expense both fell in the quarter; the senior notes were repaid and current debt is cleared, trailing interest expense being {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_expense}.
Product revenue rose by about half year over year in both the release and the disaggregation note, faster than service.
Quarter and six-month product revenue are up; the forward claim itself is untestable, so this confirms direction as of the quarter only.
Service revenue, security subscriptions and technical support all rose and remaining performance obligations are higher at each filing; the forward claim is untestable.
No product-level margin field exists; MD&A says product margin rose this quarter while total gross margin is the lowest of six filled quarters, so the full-year decline cannot be tested yet.

GAAP gross margin fell year over year and quarterly gross margin ({trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin}) is the lowest of six filled quarters, consistent with a slight service-margin decline as service cost of revenue rose.
No number isolates tariff cost.
Product gross profit and product cost of revenue both rose; the calculator computes no product-margin ratio, so the stated margin gain is neither confirmed nor contradicted.

GAAP operating margin rose year over year in the quarter and trailing operating margin of {ratios.profitability.operating_margin} is above the 2025 fiscal-year {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin}.
R&D rose in the quarter and the six months.
Sales and marketing and segment sales commissions rose in the quarter and the six months.
G&A rose in the quarter; the legal matters carry zero accruals.
No allowance row exists at quarter end, so the higher provision cannot be seen in the reserve; the annual ratio for 2025 was slightly above 2024.
The release reports the same upgrade.

Six-month operating cash flow rose strongly, and non-current deferred revenue, the deferred-revenue cash-flow line and deferred contract costs all rose as MD&A states.
Land rose and the real-estate asset acquisition is tagged for the six months; the release adds the purchase back in adjusted free cash flow.
No number bears on the plan.
No number bears on the plan.
Revenue, operating income and net income all rose year over year; the prior guidance is not in the inputs, so the beat itself is untested.

Trailing revenue growth of {growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} and the quarter's growth are consistent with a raised full-year range that sits above 2025 revenue; the prior range is not in the inputs.
The ranges are forward; the numbers reader notes the billings, operating-margin and EPS ranges sit below the quarter just reported while the revenue range brackets it.
No filed fact names the collaboration or a related commitment.
The release's reconciliation prints the real-estate add-back in both periods; whether the measure is new remains unresolved.

anomalies.what: The release defines a measure the 10-Q does not, adding back land and building purchases made for data centres and offices; the add-back was large a year ago. Simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} here does not add it back.

anomalies.name: Capital-expenditure tag differs between the 10-K and the 10-Q
anomalies.name_ko: 연차보고서와 분기보고서의 자본적지출 태그가 다름
anomalies.what: The 10-K tags productive assets, the 10-Q tags property and equipment, and the 10-Q's productive-assets row equals the real-estate purchase; trailing capital expenditure of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} therefore mixes definitions and may understate the real-estate outlay.

anomalies.name: Purchase commitments doubled with no filed fact in the record
anomalies.name_ko: 구매약정이 두 배로 늘었으나 기록에 태그된 사실 없음
anomalies.what: MD&A states non-cancelable commitments roughly doubled from year end, with a multi-year supply and pricing arrangement; the calculator's unconditional purchase obligations field is missing, so the obligation is off the balance sheet and outside the numbers.

anomalies.name: Cash taxes paid fell while the tax provision rose
anomalies.name_ko: 법인세 납부액은 줄고 법인세비용은 증가
anomalies.what: Six-month income taxes paid are below the prior year while the provision is higher and the deferred-tax-asset line is near flat; the gap lifts operating cash flow and the prose does not explain it. The trailing effective rate is {tax_rate|pct}.

anomalies.name: Repurchases exceed net income and equity falls
anomalies.name_ko: 자사주 매입이 순이익을 초과하고 자본이 감소
anomalies.what: Trailing repurchases of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases} against trailing net income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income}; equity {terms.balances_now.stockholders_equity} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.stockholders_equity}. Disclosed and funded from cash and the note repayment, not from borrowing.

anomalies.name: CFO and COO adopted trading plans in June before the release
anomalies.name_ko: 최고재무책임자와 최고운영책임자가 발표 전 사전 매매계획 채택
anomalies.what: Both plans are disclosed in the 10-Q and run from September 2026; the CFO's covers a trivial share count plus net vested shares. Listed as a signal, not a finding of substance.

anomalies.name: Subsequent-events note removed; authorization unchanged since early May
anomalies.name_ko: 후속사건 주석 삭제, 잔여 매입한도는 오월 초 이후 변동 없음
anomalies.what: The current 10-Q has no subsequent-events note, and the remaining authorization at quarter end equals the prior 10-Q's early-May value, implying no repurchases in the back half of the quarter after heavy first-half buying.

anomalies.name: Functional-currency sentences removed as FX losses rise
anomalies.name_ko: 환손실 증가 시점에 기능통화 문장 삭제
anomalies.what: The consolidation note dropped the functional-currency disclosure, including the January 2026 change for one subsidiary, in the quarter MD&A cites higher foreign-exchange losses in other income—net.

anomalies.name: Distributor C receivables-concentration row absent
anomalies.name_ko: 유통사 C의 매출채권 집중도 행이 누락
anomalies.what: The second-quarter 10-Q tags receivables concentration for A and B only; C was {concentration.facts.29.value} in the first-quarter 10-Q and {concentration.facts.21.value} at year end. Dropping below a disclosure threshold is the benign reading.

anomalies.name: Current deferred revenue tagged differently in the 10-K and the 10-Qs
anomalies.name_ko: 유동 이연수익의 태그가 연차보고서와 분기보고서에서 다름
anomalies.what: Same value at year end under two concepts, with no superseded mark; a tag change, not a restatement, but the trend table's year-end inputs come from 10-Q rows.

anomalies.name: Intel collaboration appears only in the release
anomalies.name_ko: 인텔 협업은 실적 발표에만 등장
anomalies.what: The release announces a processor collaboration; the 10-Q discloses multi-year supply and pricing arrangements and doubled purchase commitments without naming it. No filed fact ties them.

anomalies.name: Three-month operating cash flow printed only in the release
anomalies.name_ko: 분기 영업현금흐름은 실적 발표에만 인쇄됨
anomalies.what: The 10-Q states six months; the calculator derives the quarter as {growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}, which matches the release figure.

anomalies.name: Purchase commitments far exceed inventory on hand
anomalies.name_ko: 구매약정이 보유 재고를 크게 초과
anomalies.what: Commitments that MD&A says roughly doubled stand against net inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory} and quarterly days of inventory of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}; the company cites demand, lead times and component costs. Exposure if hardware demand turns.

anomalies.name: Distributor A's share of receivables fell from year end
anomalies.name_ko: 유통사 A의 매출채권 비중이 연말 대비 하락
anomalies.what: {concentration.facts.36.value} now against {concentration.facts.22.value} at year end, while its revenue share is {concentration.facts.30.value}; the largest distributor is carrying less of the receivable, the opposite of a channel-loading pattern.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 네 분기 영업현금흐름은 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배로 2025년의 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배보다 높고, 발생액 비율은 {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}로 현금이 이익을 앞서고 있습니다. 운전자본이 이익을 흡수하는 정도는 작으나 재고의 대조 차이 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}는 재고충당금 감소와 맞물려 있고, 이익의 변동성은 현금흐름의 {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}배에 그칩니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 매출채권 회전일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일로 직전 분기 {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일보다 낮아졌고, 분기 매출 대비 계약부채 비율은 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}로 여섯 분기 중 최저이지만 이는 가격 인상에 힘입은 제품 매출 급증 때문입니다. 다음 분기 빌링 가이던스가 이번 분기 실적보다 낮아 선매수 가능성은 열려 있으나 채권 수치에는 그 징후가 없습니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 재고 평가충당금 비율이 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}로 여섯 분기 중 최저이며, 충당금 잔액은 {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory_reserve}에서 {terms.balances_now.inventory_reserve}로 줄었는데 재고 평가손실은 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down}로 태그되어 있고 회사는 그 이유를 밝히지 않았습니다. 세율은 {tax_rate|pct}로 하락 요인이 없고 영업권 손상도 없습니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 소프트웨어 개발비 자본화는 없고 연구개발비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}는 전액 비용 처리됩니다. 이연계약원가(판매수수료)의 자본화가 상각을 웃돌며 늘고 있고, 비GAAP 조정의 핵심은 주식보상 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}로 전년도 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.share_based_compensation}보다 커졌습니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망 금융은 기록에 없고 영업현금흐름 증가는 고객 선수금에서 나옵니다. 다만 실적 발표의 조정 잉여현금흐름은 부동산 매입을 다시 더하고, 비취소 구매약정은 연말 대비 약 두 배로 늘었으나 계산기에 해당 필드가 없으며, 주식보상을 차감한 품질조정 잉여현금흐름은 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}로 단순 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}보다 작습니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 감사인 변경, 중요한 취약점, 지연 공시, 정정 공시는 없고 내부통제는 유효하다고 결론지었습니다. 다만 최고재무책임자와 최고운영책임자가 발표 직전 사전 매매계획을 채택했고, 후속사건 주석과 기능통화 문장, 유통사 C의 채권 집중도 행이 삭제되었습니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 실적 발표와 분기보고서의 수치는 비교한 모든 항목에서 일치했고, 발표의 분기 영업현금흐름 {growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}도 계산기의 도출값과 같습니다. 방향성을 가진 주석 항목 중 숫자와 모순되는 것은 없으며, 미해결 항목은 계산기에 필드가 없는 구매약정, 대손충당금, 제품 마진과 미래 전망뿐입니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고충당금 비율 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}가 최저인 가운데 분기 재고일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}일로 빨라졌고, 구매약정은 재고 {terms.balances_now.inventory}를 크게 웃돕니다. 상위 유통사 비중은 A {concentration.facts.30.value}, B {concentration.facts.32.value}, C {concentration.facts.34.value}로 안정적이고, 채널 밀어내기나 순환거래의 징후는 숫자에 없습니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
